# Donor Stewardship Workflow Templates

## Template 1: New Donor Welcome Series

### Timeline: Days 1-90

**Day 1-2: Immediate Acknowledgment**
- [ ] Send automated email receipt (within 24 hours)
- [ ] Log gift in CRM
- [ ] Assign donor to portfolio/stewardship tier

**Day 3-5: Personal Thank You**
- [ ] Mail handwritten thank you note
- [ ] Include impact statement specific to their gift
- [ ] Add personal touch (reference communication/connection)

**Week 2: Impact Communication**
- [ ] Send impact story email/newsletter
- [ ] Share how similar gifts have made a difference
- [ ] Include photo/video if available

**Week 4: Relationship Building**
- [ ] Make welcome phone call (if major donor)
- [ ] Invite to relevant event or tour
- [ ] Send organizational update

**Day 60: Second Touch**
- [ ] Share success story related to their area of interest
- [ ] Provide program update
- [ ] No ask—pure stewardship

**Day 90: Engagement Check**
- [ ] Review engagement level
- [ ] Send survey or feedback request
- [ ] Plan next stewardship action

---

## Template 2: Annual Donor Retention Workflow

### Quarterly Touchpoints

**Q1: Gratitude & Impact**
- [ ] Send annual impact report
- [ ] Share year-end financials
- [ ] Thank you video from leadership/beneficiaries
- [ ] Phone call to top 20% of donors

**Q2: Engagement**
- [ ] Invite to spring event
- [ ] Share mid-year program updates
- [ ] Send personalized newsletter
- [ ] Behind-the-scenes content

**Q3: Relationship Deepening**
- [ ] Offer site visit or program observation
- [ ] Request feedback/input on initiatives
- [ ] Share donor spotlight stories
- [ ] Personal note from program staff

**Q4: Year-End Connection**
- [ ] Send impact highlights email series
- [ ] Make personal phone calls (major donors)
- [ ] Holiday greeting card
- [ ] Year-end appeal (strategic timing)

---

## Template 3: Major Donor Stewardship (Annual Cycle)

### For donors $5,000+

**Within 48 Hours of Gift**
- [ ] Phone call from ED or Board Member
- [ ] Email acknowledgment with tax receipt
- [ ] Log in CRM with detailed notes

**Week 1**
- [ ] Handwritten note from leadership
- [ ] Gift processing confirmation
- [ ] Add to major donor tracking system

**Month 1**
- [ ] Schedule 1-on-1 meeting or coffee
- [ ] Send personalized impact report
- [ ] Assign dedicated relationship manager

**Month 2-3**
- [ ] Exclusive program update or briefing
- [ ] Invite to exclusive donor event
- [ ] Share financial stewardship information

**Months 4-6 (Quarterly)**
- [ ] Personal phone call or meeting
- [ ] Customized impact update
- [ ] Invite input on strategic direction
- [ ] Site visit or program tour opportunity

**Months 7-9**
- [ ] Send impact story featuring their support
- [ ] Invitation to special recognition event
- [ ] Progress report on funded initiative

**Months 10-12**
- [ ] Annual review meeting
- [ ] Present multi-year impact data
- [ ] Recognition in annual report
- [ ] Discuss continued partnership

**Pre-Renewal (30-60 days before)**
- [ ] Strategic conversation about next year
- [ ] Present funding opportunities
- [ ] Discuss giving goals

---

## Template 4: Lapsed Donor Reactivation

### For donors who haven't given in 13-24 months

**Week 1: Research**
- [ ] Review giving history in CRM
- [ ] Check engagement metrics (emails opened, events attended)
- [ ] Note last meaningful contact
- [ ] Identify reason for lapse if known

**Week 2: Re-engagement**
- [ ] Send "we miss you" personalized email
- [ ] Share exciting organizational updates
- [ ] No ask—just reconnection
- [ ] Include easy way to update preferences

**Week 3: Value Reminder**
- [ ] Send impact story from when they were active
- [ ] Highlight how their past gifts made a difference
- [ ] Include current need related to their interests

**Week 4: Phone Outreach**
- [ ] Call to reconnect (script provided)
- [ ] Ask about their experience
- [ ] Listen for feedback
- [ ] Update contact information

**Week 6: Soft Ask**
- [ ] Send targeted appeal based on previous giving
- [ ] Offer multiple engagement options
- [ ] Include match or incentive if available
- [ ] Make it easy to give

**Week 8: Alternative Engagement**
- [ ] If no gift, invite to event
- [ ] Offer volunteer opportunity
- [ ] Request feedback or survey
- [ ] Keep in communication flow

---

## Template 5: Monthly Recurring Donor Stewardship

### Ongoing Sustainers Program

**Welcome Sequence**
- [ ] Day 1: Automated thank you email
- [ ] Day 3: Welcome packet mailed (card, sticker, info)
- [ ] Day 7: Impact video email
- [ ] Day 30: Personal thank you call

**Monthly Touchpoints**
- [ ] Exclusive monthly impact email (mid-month)
- [ ] Gift processing confirmation email
- [ ] Special "sustainer-only" content quarterly

**Quarterly Actions**
- [ ] Cumulative impact statement
- [ ] Exclusive Q&A or virtual event
- [ ] Recognition in materials
- [ ] Anniversary acknowledgment

**Annual Recognition**
- [ ] Anniversary email/card
- [ ] Special gift or token of appreciation
- [ ] Invitation to annual sustainer event
- [ ] Annual impact report with year totals

**Retention Activities**
- [ ] Failed payment follow-up within 48 hours
- [ ] Update request email biannually
- [ ] Exit survey if cancellation occurs
- [ ] Win-back campaign for lapsed sustainers

---

## Template 6: Event Donor Follow-Up

### Post-Event Stewardship Workflow

**Within 24 Hours**
- [ ] Send thank you email to all attendees
- [ ] Post event photos on social media
- [ ] Tag attendees (with permission)

**Days 2-3**
- [ ] Mail tax receipts for auction/paddle raise
- [ ] Send personal thanks to sponsors/table buyers
- [ ] Follow up on pledges

**Week 1**
- [ ] Share event impact/funds raised
- [ ] Send photo gallery link
- [ ] Post highlight video
- [ ] Make thank you calls to VIP attendees

**Week 2**
- [ ] Mail formal thank you letters
- [ ] Include event wrap-up report
- [ ] Share testimonials or stories from event

**Week 4**
- [ ] Survey attendees for feedback
- [ ] Begin cultivation for next year
- [ ] Invite to next engagement opportunity

**Month 2-3**
- [ ] Share how event funds are being used
- [ ] Impact update specific to event goals
- [ ] Continue regular stewardship cycle

---

## Template 7: Grant Stewardship (Foundations/Corporations)

### Award to Renewal Cycle

**Upon Award**
- [ ] Send formal acceptance letter
- [ ] Confirm reporting requirements
- [ ] Set up tracking system
- [ ] Schedule internal check-ins

**Month 1**
- [ ] Thank you letter to program officer
- [ ] Announce grant (if approved)
- [ ] Set up dedicated project tracking

**Quarterly**
- [ ] Send informal progress update
- [ ] Share relevant program highlights
- [ ] Invite to site visit
- [ ] Include in stakeholder communications

**Mid-Point**
- [ ] Submit interim report (if required)
- [ ] Request feedback meeting
- [ ] Share early outcomes/data
- [ ] Address any concerns

**Pre-Final Report (30 days)**
- [ ] Compile outcomes data
- [ ] Gather testimonials/stories
- [ ] Prepare financial documentation
- [ ] Create visual impact summary

**Final Report**
- [ ] Submit comprehensive report
- [ ] Include multimedia elements
- [ ] Highlight impact and outcomes
- [ ] Express gratitude

**Post-Grant**
- [ ] Share continued impact (3-6 months after)
- [ ] Maintain relationship cultivation
- [ ] Begin renewal conversation (if applicable)
- [ ] Invite to ongoing engagement
